description: This file defines a report parser class for generating cost ledger reports related to analytic accounts in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including methods for data retrieval and calculations.

classes.name: account_analytic_cost_ledger
classes.description: Report parser class for generating cost ledger reports, including methods for data aggregation and calculations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up context variables and data structures.

methods.name: _lines_g
methods.description: Retrieves and processes general account lines within a date range, calculating debit and credit based on balance.

methods.name: _lines_a
methods.description: Retrieves analytic line details within a date range, calculates revenue based on product prices, and updates revenue summaries.

methods.name: _account_sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates net balance (debit minus credit) for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_qty
methods.description: Calculates total quantity for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_revenue
methods.description: Retrieves total revenue for an account.

methods.name: _account_g_sum_revenue
methods.description: Retrieves total revenue for a general account.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit for multiple accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit for multiple accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates net balance for multiple accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_qty
methods.description: Calculates total quantity for multiple accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_revenue
methods.description: Calculates total revenue across multiple accounts.
